title: finding(app-shell,i18n): `preview.history.items` is a bare plural concatenated after a count — ungrammatical at one item in six of the ten packs, and it is the precedent the repo cites for this shape
body: Found by the `os-dev` seat delivering objectui#9170 while repairing the identical defect on `kanban.columns`. Filed by the `domain:ui` PM seat because the seat's dedup channels were down (MCP `search_issues` rate-limited on the MCP server's own identity, user ID `327383522`; its first query returned empty and it correctly refused to treat an empty result from an unproven instrument as a reading). **Re-measured and widened here before filing.** Dedup run by enumerating all 452 open issues — one hit (objectui#4249), unrelated. ⛔ Filed as a `finding` only. Grading is the triage seat's. ## The defect `packages/app-shell/src/preview/CommitTimeline.tsx:171` composes a count by **concatenation**, exactly the shape objectui#9170 exists to remove from the kanban board: ```tsx {c.itemCount} {t('preview.history.items', { defaultValue: 'item(s)' })} ``` The pack supplies a bare unit word with no `count` and no plural family, so the word never agrees with the number in front of it. ## Measured — all ten packs, read from `packages/i18n/src/locales/*.ts` | pack | value | at `itemCount: 1` | |:--|:--|:--| | `en` | `item(s)` | ✅ count-agnostic **by construction** — this is why the defect is invisible in English | | `ja` | `件` | ✅ counter word, no plural distinction | | `ko` | `항목` | ✅ no plural distinction | | `zh` | `项` | ✅ no plural distinction | | `de` | `Elemente` | ⛔ `1 Elemente` | | `es` | `elementos` | ⛔ `1 elementos` | | `fr` | `éléments` | ⛔ `1 éléments` | | `pt` | `itens` | ⛔ `1 itens` | | `ru` | `элементов` | ⛔ `1 элементов` — genitive plural | | `ar` | `عناصر` | ⛔ `1 عناصر` | ⇒ **six** packs render ungrammatically at one item. ⚠️ The source report named `ru` and `ko`; `ko` is in fact **correct** (Korean marks no plural) and five further packs — `de` / `es` / `fr` / `pt` / `ar` — were not named. The `en` row is the reason this has survived: it is the only pack whose value was authored to dodge the problem. ⚠️ Reachability at `itemCount === 1` is derived from the call site and the pack values, **not** from a run probe. A repair round should render it. ## ⭐ Why this one matters more than an ordinary i18n nit `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/residue-namespaces-3546.test.tsx` cites this exact key as **the repo's precedent** for the bare-unit-word shape, and pins it: ``` expect(at(builtInLocales.en, 'preview.history.items')).toBe('item(s)'); expect(at(builtInLocales.ko, 'preview.history.items')).toBe('항목'); expect(at(builtInLocales.ru, 'preview.history.items')).toBe('элементов'); ``` with the comment calling it *"the same structure as `preview.history.items` (slice five, **which had to be corrected once for exactly this reason**)"*. ⇒ the precedent that is teaching new code this shape is **itself defective in six locales**, and the pin currently locks the defect in place: `ru`'s bare genitive plural is asserted as correct. Any repair must **re-derive that pin**, ⛔ not delete it. ## The routes, and the one already ruled next door objectui#9170 asked the same question about `kanban.columns` and it was **ruled**: the maintainer chose **route 3 — drop the number from the string entirely** (director seat, decision batch #118 item 3, 2026-09-12T02:14Z, maintainer verbatim 「其他同意」), with a plural family named as a fallback **not needed**. ⚠️ That ruling is **not** automatically this card's answer, and ⛔ should not be applied by analogy: - On the kanban board the count was **redundant** — the lanes are visible, and the rationale was that read aloud the number is noise. - Here the count **is the content**. `{itemCount} items` in a commit-history row is the only place that number appears; dropping it deletes information rather than de-duplicating it. ⇒ the live options are a real plural family (`_one`/`_other`, keys required in **all ten** packs per `all-locales-key-parity` — only the *value* may repeat), or the `en`-style count-agnostic device per pack, or a colon/parenthetical form as at `fields.textarea.charactersRemaining` (`en.ts:391`). ⛔ Whoever takes it should read the objectui#9170 ruling for the reasoning, then decide on this surface's own facts. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_
